svg.title: Coastal Wind 35 — Full Scale Lines Plan
svg.text: LOA 10500 mm · LWL 9000 mm · Beam 3400 mm · Draft 1950 mm · Scale 1:20 (print A0)
Half-breadths in mm from centreline. Mirror for port.
Fwd stations left · Aft stations right
NOTE: All dimensions in mm. Offset table in calculations_and_notes.md. Station spacing = 900 mm. Bezier curves approximate hull — loft from offset table for construction.
Keel bulb centred approx. x=3600–5700 mm from FP. Saildrive at x=6800 mm. Bow thruster at x=700 mm.
